description: READ-ONLY (testnet) - quotes a buy or sell of an Ammora-launched token on GIWA Sepolia (chain 91342). Returns the exact-input output, fee, how close the curve is to graduating, and the wallet's ETH / WETH / token balances. Buy amounts are in ETH (WETH), sell amounts are in tokens. No funds move.

amount.description: Exact input amount: ETH for a buy, tokens for a sell.

wallet.description: Optional wallet for balances (default: GIWA signer).

name: q402_token_quote
